summary: MILLI rebrand iteration — verified all new endpoints (onboarding, vault, smart accounts, quarterly, deposits/manual-v2, vault/connect-plaid) and ran a full frontend E2E from Landing → Register → 8-step Onboarding → /app → Vault → Settings → Quarterly → Retirement → Investing. Backend: 49/49 pytest passing. Frontend: full happy-path traversed successfully with no JS errors.

minor.issue: Uses body.dict(exclude_none=True) so passing fixed_percentage=null cannot CLEAR a previously-set fixed percentage — the field is silently dropped and the old value persists. Same on PUT /api/smart/{kind}/rule. Consider explicit sentinel (e.g. -1) or accept None as 'reset to strategy default'.

When called with a fake/invalid public_token both surface a 500 from the upstream Plaid exception. They DO return JSON (no crash), but a 502/400 with a sanitized message would be more correct than 500.

integration_issues.flow: Vault page after clicking 'Open Milli Reserve'
integration_issues.issue: vault-balance-card not visible within 2.5s after setup click. Likely the global 5s Splash overlay on next render is masking the page or the load() refetch races with re-render. Not blocking — settings page later confirms vault was created.

issues: Cinematic splash plays on EVERY route change/page load (~5s). UX-heavy — consider playing only once per session via sessionStorage. Currently every navigation between /app/vault, /app/settings, /app/quarterly etc. blocks the screen for 5s.

action_items: Decide if PUT /vault/rule and /smart/*/rule should be able to clear fixed_percentage back to null (currently impossible).
Wrap Plaid exchange errors to return 400 with sanitized error_code instead of 500.
Consider gating Splash via sessionStorage so it plays once per session instead of every route load (huge UX win).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1549 lines — should be split into routers (auth, vault, smart, quarterly, plaid, deposits, ai, reports, stripe).
Vault/smart rule update uses dict(exclude_none=True) which prevents clearing optional fields — design bug.
_get_vault and _smart_get duplicate the find_one + projection pattern — could be unified.
All MongoDB calls properly exclude _id via projection — good.
JWT secret is a real-looking hex in .env (committed to repo) — acceptable for preview but rotate before production.
STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent is a placeholder; checkout still works because the integration appears to mock or use Emergent's Stripe key resolution.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_milli_backend.py is module-scoped — fixtures register one fresh user and chain through tests. Run order matters within TestDepositsV2AutoAllocation (it depends on TestVault + TestSmartAccounts running first). Use addopts override (-o 'addopts=') to disable xdist parallelism (pytest.ini sets -n auto which breaks fixture sharing). Existing test_taxhaul_backend.py covers legacy endpoints (auth, deposits, trips, expenses, tax/summary, reports, pricing, stripe, ai, OCR, protected) — still relevant.
rca of the issue: PUT /vault/rule fixed_percentage cannot be cleared: body.dict(exclude_none=True) drops null values, so the previously-stored fixed_percentage (e.g. 0.30) persists even when the client passes None to revert to strategy-based calc. Caught by test_manual_v2_auto_allocates which initially expected 25% (balanced) but got 30% (stale fixed_percentage). Mitigation: either remove exclude_none for fixed_percentage specifically, or use a sentinel value, or have client pass strategy and recompute server-side.
